name: Extract YouTube and TikTok transcripts to clean text with Apify

parameters.content:
## Extract YouTube and TikTok transcripts to clean text

Paste a mixed list of YouTube and TikTok links and get one clean row per video: title, author, word count and the full transcript. Use it as the first step for summaries, blog posts, newsletters or a RAG knowledge base.

### How it works
1. **Set video links** holds your list. YouTube videos, Shorts, playlists, whole channels (`https://www.youtube.com/@handle`) and TikTok links (including `tiktok.com/t/...` share links) can be mixed.
2. **Split links by platform** groups the links so each platform is one batch request.
3. **Get transcripts from Apify** calls two Apify Actors synchronously (no polling). YouTube videos without captions are transcribed with Whisper (`aiFallback: true`).
4. **Classify Apify results** checks every row. **Successful content?** sends only `status: ok` rows with nonempty transcript text and no error to **Format transcript fields**. Successful fields remain `status, url, title, author, source, wordCount, transcript`.
5. Failed, no-speech, timed-out, empty or unlinked results go to **Errors - inspect before retry** with available recovery information, never into `transcript`.

### Setup steps (2 min)
1. Create an Apify account and copy your API token (Console > Settings > API & Integrations).
2. Open **Get transcripts from Apify** and create a *Header Auth* credential: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer <your token>`.
3. Replace the example links in **Set video links** and click *Execute workflow*.

### Customization
Connect **Format transcript fields** to an AI model, Google Sheets or a vector store. Keep **Errors - inspect before retry** separate. This template does not include an LLM node.

### Costs and timeouts
The original `aiFallback: true` YouTube request is unchanged: videos without captions may incur AI transcription charges. Set it to false for captions-only YouTube processing. TikTok settings are unchanged. Result-fee waivers do not waive Actor Start, platform or downstream service costs. The sync endpoint can time out after 300 seconds while the Actor continues; check its existing run/dataset before retrying. Completed responses are retained at the HTTP node before workflow JSON parsing. Header recovery IDs and HTTP status survive malformed JSON; no raw body or headers are copied into diagnostics. If a connection fails before n8n exposes a response, recovery metadata may be unavailable.

*Disclosure: I maintain both Apify Actors used here.*

## 1. Add your links
Edit the list in **Set video links**. YouTube and TikTok links can be mixed.

## 2. Fetch transcripts
One Apify call per platform. Add your Apify token as a Header Auth credential.

## 3. Separate content from diagnostics
Only the true branch reaches the existing content formatter. Connect downstream LLMs here only.

The false branch ends at **Errors - inspect before retry**. Inspect status/error and available run/dataset IDs. Never treat an error message as transcript or summary, or blindly rerun a timeout.
